concerns.text: Plan's structure lists only 4 contracts (dataset, motif_profile, output, structural_connectome), but the contracts/ directory also contains analysis_results.schema.yaml and results.schema.yaml. Neither is referenced by any plan task (T001–T017) or the data-model's file-format list, so they are orphaned — no plan element exercises them, violating plan↔contracts coverage. Either delete them or add a task/contract-test mapping.

results.schema.yaml hard-codes exactly four motif fields (motif_triangle_z, motif_path_z, motif_edge_z, motif_isolated_z) and a network_density field, contradicting the plan/data-model's 13-motif (3- and 4-node) framing and subject_metrics.csv columns (subject_id, rsfc_strength, global_efficiency, global_degree). This contract cannot validate the planned outputs.

analysis_results.schema.yaml requires method_used with enum {multivariate_regression, ridge_regression, permutation_only} and a per-record vif for 'the control variable', but the plan (T007) and output.schema.yaml describe VIF over the full motif predictor set with no ridge/multivariate method selection step. The two results contracts disagree with each other and with the plan.

Traceability maps SC-001 ('≥95% of subjects have BOTH structural and rsFC files') to T002's cohort_actual check, yet the plan's own gating design means structural.npy will not exist for any subject when no verified diffusion source is available. The mapping presents SC-001 as satisfied while the plan's stated behavior cannot satisfy it; the surfaced spec mismatch should also be reflected here (e.g. mark SC-001 as blocked/gated) rather than checked as ✅-equivalent.
Task IDs jump from T011 to T017 with no T012–T016; either renumber or note the gap to avoid downstream traceability confusion.
